lede: Know where to ride, stay, eat and refill in Brda.
intro: Brda is a region of vineyard hills on the border with Italy, between Nova Gorica and Kanal ob Soči. Three signed routes cross it: the international road route Bimobis, R2 (Nova Gorica–Dobrovo–Kanal) and the local route La valle dello Judrio. Dobrovo, Medana, Šmartno and Podsabotin are among the villages you pass.

routes.title: Cycle routes through Brda
routes.body: Three signed routes pass through Brda, and Bimobis carries you through the middle. It is an international road route of 144 km, with 25 km inside Brda, passing Dobrovo and Medana. R2 (Nova Gorica–Dobrovo–Kanal), a national route, runs 5 km through Brda. La valle dello Judrio is a local route of 24 km, 4 km of it in Brda.

stays.title: Where to stay with your bike
stays.body: Brda has 8 places to stay, and the four below are on wine estates, a farm and a castle. B&B Bužinel is 12 metres from Bimobis, with a restaurant and its own wine under the same name. Alma Vista, 32 metres from the route, is a villa for up to six with a private pool, part of the Edi Simčič wine estate. Hotel Gredič, 611 metres from R2, has its rooms inside the walls of a castle. Turistična kmetija Breg stands on a hill above the Idrija river, 146 metres from La valle dello Judrio.

food.title: Where to stop and eat
food.body: You have 10 places to eat in Brda, and three of them sit within 25 metres of Bimobis. In Medana, Ošterija Klinec cooks seasonal home food with organic wine from its own cellar; it opens Friday to Monday, so check the hours before you set off. Vino Modana, also in Medana, is mostly a fish kitchen, known for its mussels. Bužinel is 24 metres from the route. At the entrance to Brda in Podsabotin, Turistična kmetija Štanfel has a place to charge and store e-bikes.

practical.title: Water, repair and charging
practical.body: You can refill a bottle at 11 public water points, and 6 of them are within 150 metres of a signed route. There is no public repair stand in Brda. The nearest bike shop is Cicli Buz, 8.4 km away. Riding an e-bike? Brda has one public charger, so plan your stops.

sights.title: What to see on the way
sights.body: Brda has 13 sights, and Dobrovo Castle is the one right on your way. It stands 21 metres from Bimobis, in the village of the same name.
